new_findings.title: S4.24b gofmt list omits the 7th write-set file
new_findings.evidence: gofmt -l lists 6 paths but the write set (:3162, :3169) and Plan :1338 declare 7; the new cmd/han-server/recovery_exclusive_unsupported_integration_test.go is unchecked by the format gate
new_findings.impact: Format gate can stay green without covering the new test file; does not affect implementability
new_findings.suggestion: Add the path to :3174 (command count stays 12, single-line content change)

new_findings.title: Non-POSIX negative-test commands are not platform-pinned and can pass vacuously on POSIX hosts
new_findings.evidence: Commands run go test [-race] -tags=integration ./cmd/han-server -run ^TestRecoveryDeploymentExclusiveUnsupportedPlatform$ without GOOS; the test file carries a !(POSIX) build tag, so on Linux/macOS it is excluded and go test exits 0 with no tests executed; :3187 and :3188(5) rely on this test as the sole evidence for (e)
new_findings.impact: On POSIX CI, close condition (5) can be satisfied without executing any assertion (false pass); no planning-level error, but the S4.24b negative gate would be ineffective
new_findings.suggestion: Pin a non-POSIX platform (e.g. GOOS=windows or a Windows runner) and record GOOS; add to :3188(5) a requirement that -json shows the test actually ran (run/pass events, not "no tests to run")
new_findings.close_condition: :3182/:3183 bind a platform and :3188(5) forbids a vacuous pass
